name: Arzana
long_description:
Arzana trains custom models on manufacturers' operational data to automate their quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other repetitive office work. We've saved our customers over $1.5M in avoided staff costs.

In the future, we'll expand into shop-floor automation, sending instructions to machinery and robots to produce the orders that our office agents processed. By 2035, we aim to fully automate 10,000 American factories.

launches.body:
Arzana is automating the factory office with AI.\
\
<https://youtu.be/wbtqEbvezZI?si=XPbpGkzK6XuLnR8B>

American manufacturers waste billions on office staff dedicated to keying in orders, building quotes, and chasing invoices.

And when their salespeople get roped into the mess, growth efforts grind to a halt.

Arzana automates this repetitive office work with a suite of custom AI Agents that integrate with existing email, ERP, and other systems and handle order entry, quoting, and other mundane tasks.

The most innovative manufacturers in the country are already using Arzana to process quotes and orders 10x faster, make 70% fewer data-entry errors, and save millions of dollars each year.
